description: Phase 2 — Content pipeline: markdown blog, categories, initial posts, RSS feed

userStories.title: Create markdown content directory and parser
userStories.description: Create content/posts/ directory, frontmatter schema, gray-matter + react-markdown setup, utility functions getPosts() and getPost(slug)
acceptanceCriteria: gray-matter and react-markdown with remark-gfm installed
getPosts() returns sorted array of posts from markdown files
Frontmatter schema: title, date, category, tags, excerpt, readingTime, featured
userStories.notes: This is a Vite/React app — markdown loading needs to work client-side or via import. Consider using import.meta.glob for loading .md files.

userStories.title: Migrate existing essay to markdown
userStories.description: Convert The Unraveling of a Promise from essays.ts to content/posts/ markdown file
userStories.notes: Keep essays.ts working alongside new markdown system during migration
